doc: Waits for GPU draw sync (DrawSync(0)), then derives a primitive tag/timestamp pair from the leading 32-bit word at *a0: bits [22:0] form an id field, bit 31 is a flag, bits [30:23] an offset. If the id field is nonzero, it is OR'd with 0x80000000 and paired with the raw D_8008148C.field_0 timestamp. Otherwise the base timestamp is D_8008148C.field_0 plus the offset field (masked 0xFF800000, shifted right 12). Either way the chosen base timestamp is stashed into D_80081480.field_0, then func_8003E4FC(6, a0, 0) and func_8003F320() are called, and finally func_80041344 is invoked with the id/timestamp pair.

globals.name: D_80081480
globals.decl: struct { s32 field_0; s8 pad[8]; } D_80081480; // only field_0 @ offset 0 accessed; declared >8B to force hi/lo addressing (see also func_80041AB0, func_80043CD0)
